events.description: Rachel Green says Chandler Bing should get off.
Phoebe Buffay says an unspecified person should give Phoebe Buffay something.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani can see Phoebe Buffay operating a drill press.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not know.
Joey Tribbiani asks what Phoebe Buffay is wearing.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay wants to operate a drill press.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay plans to get back some of Phoebe Buffay's massage clients.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay was a dummie.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay taught a "massage-yourself-at-home" workshop.
Phoebe Buffay says the massage clients are massaging themselves at home.
Joey Tribbiani says Phoebe Buffay could work for Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani's suggestion that Phoebe Buffay work for Chandler Bing is a good idea.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay could do the job working for Chandler Bing.
Phoebe Buffay asks what the job is.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing's secretary will be out for a couple of weeks.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing's secretary is having one of her boobs reduced.
Chandler Bing says the situation with Chandler Bing's secretary is a whole big boob story.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay could be a secretary for Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not know if the secretary job is Phoebe Buffay's kind of thing.
Chandler Bing says the secretary job involves a lot of being normal for a large portion of the day.
Rachel Green asks what Ross Geller is playing with.
Ross Geller says the thing Ross Geller is playing with is Ross Geller's new beeper.
Joey Tribbiani asks why Ross Geller, a paleontologist, needs a beeper.
Monica Geller says the beeper is for dinosaur emergencies.
Monica Geller says someone should help and come quickly because the dinosaurs are still extinct.
Ross Geller says the beeper is for when Carol Willick goes into labor.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick can reach Ross Geller wherever Ross Geller is, and all Carol Willick has to do is dial 55-JIMBO.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller will see Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing later.
Rachel Green thanks Monica Geller.
Joey Tribbiani asks how young Young Ethan is.
Monica Geller says Young Ethan is the same age as Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing asks when Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing were that age.
Monica Geller says Young Ethan is a senior in college.
Chandler Bing asks whether Young Ethan has any problem with how old Monica Geller is.
Monica Geller says the age difference between Monica Geller and Young Ethan is not even an issue.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller told Young Ethan that Monica Geller was 22.
Monica Geller asks whether Monica Geller can pass for 22.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is 26.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller has proven the point by being 26.
